executive_summary: Maven build failed with 22 compilation errors. The primary issue is that a custom Column class conflicts with JPA's @Column annotation, causing type conversion errors across Task, User, and BoardColumn entities. Additionally, there are method signature mismatches and missing setter methods.

errors.message: Custom Column class conflicts with JPA @Column annotation causing 19 type conversion errors across Task, User, and BoardColumn entities
errors.root_cause: A custom class named 'Column' in the entities package is being confused with javax.persistence.Column annotation. The compiler expects an annotation but finds a class, causing incompatible type errors in all entity classes that use @Column annotations.
errors.fix_recommendation: Rename the custom Column class to avoid conflict with JPA's @Column annotation. Suggested names: BoardColumn, ColumnEntity, or TaskColumn. Update all references to this class throughout the codebase including imports, variable declarations, and method signatures.

errors.message: method getUserTasks cannot be applied to given types; required: Long,Pageable found: Long,int,int,String
errors.root_cause: The TaskController is calling getUserTasks with 4 parameters (Long userId, int page, int size, String sort) but the TaskService interface defines it with 2 parameters (Long userId, Pageable pageable). The method signature mismatch indicates the controller needs to construct a Pageable object.
errors.fix_recommendation: In TaskController line 46, create a Pageable object using PageRequest.of(page, size, Sort.by(sort)) and pass it to getUserTasks instead of individual parameters. Import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest and org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.

errors.root_cause: The Column entity class is missing the setLastUpdated() setter method. The InMemoryColumnDataStore attempts to call this method at lines 41 and 56 to update the lastUpdated timestamp, but the method does not exist in the Column class.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add the setLastUpdated(LocalDateTime lastUpdated) setter method to the Column entity class. Ensure the corresponding lastUpdated field exists with proper JPA annotations (@Column and temporal type if needed). Also verify getter method exists for consistency.

errors.root_cause: Same as line 41 - the Column entity class is missing the setLastUpdated() setter method required by the data store implementation.
errors.fix_recommendation: This is the same issue as the previous error. Once the setLastUpdated() method is added to the Column class, both line 41 and line 56 errors will be resolved.

summary: 4 distinct compilation errors found (with 19 instances of the Column naming conflict)
